creates_document_note: First cycle for this component. The application baseline v0.1 records identity-service as DECLARED with hld_ref null, so there is no current document to diff against. Taken as a delta against an empty document so the first HLD arrives as a reviewable diff from the same mechanism as every later amendment.
structural_assessment: Not structural. The component, its bounded context and its ownership of Producer and FoodSafetyRegistration are already declared in the FSA (APP-1.04, APP-2.04) and the data architecture (DAT-1.1). This delta describes how a declared component is built, not what the decomposition is. Nothing propagates to foundational-solution-architecture.md.

changes.content: identity-service — containerised service behind the group API gateway, own schema (identity_schema), own workload identity (wi-identity). Realises three operations: createProducerRegistration, getProducerRegistration, getRegistrationStatus.
TokenValidator (WU-F5.1-02) · RoleProvisioner (WU-F5.1-03) · RegistrationService (WU-F1.1-02, WU-F1.1-04) · FboRegisterClient (WU-F1.1-05) · ProducerRepository over identity_schema (WU-F1.1-01).

Registration submitted -> RegistrationService validates format and attestation server-side -> Producer and FoodSafetyRegistration written with status pending-verification -> FboRegisterClient queries the competent-authority register asynchronously -> outcome written, identity.registration.verified emitted.

Two outbound integrations: the group-approved external IdP (inbound authentication, WU-F5.1-01) and the competent-authority FBO register (outbound lookup, WU-F1.1-05). One outbound event: identity.registration.verified, Evidence kind, never replayed.

Availability 99.9% (ES4 — an FBO-status dispute is a regulatory-defence case). getRegistrationStatus p95 <= 250 ms, the budget INT-4.3 holds it to. FoodSafetyRegistration append-only, 6-year retention (ES3), approved PII region (ES9).

identity-service owns the eligibility DECISION and exposes it through identity.registration-status@v1. Enforcement at the point of publication is catalogue-service's and is not built this cycle. WU-F1.1-04's title says 'publication gate', which reads as Catalogue work; the decision belongs to Identity because DAT-1.1 gives Identity sole ownership of FoodSafetyRegistration, and a gate that reads another context's entity would breach CON-2.
